items.author: nekobekoneko.bsky.social
items.context: Is Final Fantasy 7 Remake worth it? I heard some people say the game is mostly cutscenes and gets boring quick. Opinions? #ff7 #ff7remake #finalfantasy #gaming
items.text: It only covers the Midgar part of the original story, so it's more linear and character-driven than open-ended. Knowing that going in helps you decide if it's your style.
items.verify: Проверь, что FF7 Remake есть на PC (Steam или Epic).

items.author: maplealcesia.bsky.social
items.context: kind of a weird and specific question but: can anyone recommend spooky/horror-focused games that are more job-focused / process-following? stuff like: - home safety hotline - carbon steel from unsorted horror - voices of the void but maybe less spooky lol
items.text: The Mortuary Assistant fits that well: you follow embalming steps while things get creepy around you. I'm on Observation Duty is another, built around checking cameras and spotting what's off.
items.verify: Проверь, что The Mortuary Assistant и I'm on Observation Duty есть в Steam и подходят под «работа по процедуре».
